LG_guard.base_controller: same frozen L high-level LLM controller/backend contract
rules_in_order: If base LLM action == CHANGE_REPRESENTATION, execute CONTINUE_LOCAL_SEARCH.
Else if previous executed action is semantic and base LLM action is semantic, execute CONTINUE_LOCAL_SEARCH for one-epoch cooldown.
Else execute base LLM action unchanged.

development_data: M01-M10 final main results were used to design the guard; follow-up evidence must come only from fresh M11-M16 calls.
interpretation_boundary: A positive result supports only improved intervention calibration / reduced shallow-failure burden. It does not overturn the main null result or establish better discovery efficiency.
multiplicity: No secondary confirmatory claims; primary is the sole inferential endpoint.

primary.test: exact two-sided paired sign-flip over six replicate differences

scientific_question: Does a deterministic representation block plus one-epoch semantic-intervention cooldown reduce shallow SCREEN8 failure burden relative to the original L controller under otherwise matched search?
secondary_descriptive: guard application count / representation blocks / cooldowns
